# Golden data files

The contract between the Go writer (`internal/datafile`) and the browser reader (F-04). Format: `architect/F-03-workout-data-file-writer.md`, section "Data file format, version 1"; decisions in ADR-005.

For every file in `../corpus/synthetic/` there are two files in `synthetic/`:

- `<name>.bin`: the exact output of `datafile.Encode` for that corpus file.
- `<name>.json`: `datafile.Fixture(Decode(<name>.bin))`: per stream the counts of valid and missing samples, first, last, min and max as stored absolute integers (before `scale`), and a SHA-256 digest of every stored integer (`-` for missing, one per line, first 16 hex characters).

They are generated by `make corpus-update` and never edited by hand. `TestDataFileCorpus` (in `go test ./...`, so CI) fails when one is missing, stale or differs from the writer; review their diff with the code. F-04's decoder tests read them.

Synthetic files only. Nothing derived from a real FIT file is ever committed (ADR-004 item 7, rev. 3); `make corpus` writes real-file data files to `build/corpus/real/` only.
